review.notes: Chain starts at v0 (RDS-EN009, 2004-12-01), the text the GOAT variant carries exactly. v0->v1 ('designate'->'target'), v1->v2 (DT05-EN009, explicit 'you can') and v2->v3 (LCYW-EN033, PSCT colon/semicolon, 'Summoned' collapsing 'Normal Summoned, Special Summoned') are cosmetic; the 2005 and 2008 rulings for this card concern only which opposing Spell effects the negation catches, which both scripts implement identically (the EFFECT_DISABLE hunk is unchanged in the diff). The remaining diff hunks - Cost.SelfToGrave written out as a local cost function, EVENT_PHASE+PHASE_STANDBY vs bitwise or, s.LVset=0xe7 vs the named SET_SILENT_SWORDSMAN constant - are upstream idiom, same values. Flagged chronology-unresolved because the script encodes both era components and only the reveal is dated: no per-card verification or activation ruling exists for this card in either archived capture, so the end date of the relaxed activation condition is unattested.

effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

corroboration.title: UDE official Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Rulings (capture 2005-06-16, inside the GOAT window)
corroboration.quote: You must show your opponent the monster you select from your Deck for this card's effect. If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Machina Mayhem Structure Deck Card Rulings, compiled April 6th 2010 (18 days before the Edison snapshot)
corroboration.quote: If you do not have "Commander Covington" in your Deck, your opponent can ask to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Storm of Ragnarok Card Rulings, compiled February 2 2011 - the latest positive attestation of the old state
corroboration.quote: If there is no longer a monster in your hand that you can Special Summon when this effect resolves, your opponent may briefly verify that this is the case.

event.historical_text: Negate the effects of your opponent's Spell Cards that designate this card. During your Standby Phase, send this face-up card to the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 "Silent Swordsman LV5" from your hand or Deck. (You cannot activate this effect the turn that this card is Normal Summoned, Special Summoned, or flipped face-up.)
event.summary: Period procedure plus a relaxed activation condition, not a text erratum: the GOAT script reduces s.sptg to the free-zone test alone (the modern Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard over hand+Deck is removed), so the Standby Phase effect can be activated - paying the send-this-card-to-the-Graveyard cost - with no "Silent Swordsman LV5" in hand or Deck, and the failure is proven by revealing hand and Deck (Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script requires an available LV5 and never reveals.
